svg.title: MegaBoomV3Config distributed scheduler
svg.desc: Proposed FIFOrder scheduler for MegaBoomV3Config. Not implemented.
svg.text: dispatch width 4, routed by iq type
writeback to the physical register files
PROPOSED, not implemented. INT and FP collapsing queues are replaced. Totals stay 40 and 32; each queue depth is TBD. MEM stays 24.
Parameters: BoomConfigs.scala MegaBoomV3Config; v3 config-mixins.scala WithNMegaBooms; core.scala; fp-pipeline.scala; execution-units.scala; issue-unit-age-ordered.scala.
Predicate register file omitted: enableSFBOpt is false. No RoCC pipe: BuildRoCC defaults to Nil. Both physical register files have 128 entries.
